INSERT INTO articles (title, url, source, published_at, category, summary, content)
VALUES ('{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.url }}', '{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.published_at }}', '{{ $json.category }}', '{{ $json.summary }}', '{{ $json.content }}')
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title;
